Sewing schedule - Alien special shape, 2,610 m3 / 92,171 cu ft

Envelope = the master patterns, full-size master patterns (no scaling): mouth O3.988 m, parachute hole O5.000 m, seal overlap 360 mm. Gore length 22.83 m; 17 rows; 20 gores. Seams: 25 mm (1 in) allowance, 5/8 in double French fell; 1 in turn-backs at mouth/parachute.

Assembly sequence

  1. Cut all panels from the 1:1 templates in this pack - 20 of each, plus 2 EXTRA panel N for the antenna doublers (~36.7 m fabric/gore, ~735 m total incl. vents, +10% waste = ~810 m; Nomex ~25 m incl. scoop). Lay every panel with its ROW HEIGHT across the 1,524 mm / 60 in bolt and its GORE WIDTH along the 3,658 mm / 12 ft table. Mark panel letter + UP arrow on each.
  2. Applique mouth pieces FLAT on panel C of gores 20/1/2 (crescent 5.09 x 1.19 m; exact edges zigzag, extensions left free).
  3. Cut eye feed holes in the ENVELOPE: gores 20/2: panel H +450 mm; gores 19/3: panel H +910 mm; gores 18/4: panel i +850 mm (O450 cut / O500 finished), each hemmed over one layer of Class 3 1/2 in tape.
  4. Lay the antenna doublers on the inside face of panel N, gores 18 & 4, then cut the feed holes through BOTH plies: O575 cut / O625 finished, centered mid-row, each hemmed over one layer of Class 3 1/2 in tape.
  5. Join panels into gores (17 rows + NOMEX); fell rows bottom-up.
  6. Join gores 1-20 over load tape; catch mouth-crescent extensions in fells 20/1 and 1/2.
  7. Build turning vents from the scaled vent-marked i/J panels at seams 15/16 & 16/17 (printed triangle sew lines, 70 mm lip).
  8. Cut and piece the eye pod SKIN: 14 pieces in 4 strips per pod (no piece over 1450 x 3450 mm, so all of them print 1:1). Join sections within each strip, then strip to strip, then check the assembled outline against the whole-shape ordinates.
  9. Fit eye pods: mark the 7.96 x 6.81 m footprint outline on the envelope, tape it, then ease the skin on (+224 mm, 5.4 % rim ease over 16 match points). Two layers - the envelope is the pod base.
  10. Fit antennae (3.75 m: 2.25 m cone + O1.5 m ball) on row N bases, 35 deg outboard lean; 350 mm equator zips.
  11. Hem mouth (O3.988 m) and aperture (O5.000 m); fit the scoop for your burner frame, hung 100 mm below the mouth, 600 mm leads.
  12. Rig parachute: confluence 3,600 mm; centering start 3,639 mm (trim to 3,598); crown line 31.0 m; red line 34.0 m via apex pulley.
  13. Final inspection: seam pull tests, vent function, pod inflation check, parachute seating.
